summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new dossier tracking system, WhatsApp button, testimonials, team section, and admin dossier management. All 22 pytest cases passed (auth, contact regression, dossier CRUD, public tracking case-insensitive/404, delete). Frontend: homepage loads with logo, French nav (Équipe/Suivi), WhatsApp floating button (wa.me/243975007535), Team DG card, 4 testimonials cards. Public tracking: existing ref GLS-2026-JB57 returned full result with progress steps + history; fake ref GLS-2026-ZZZZ showed French error. Admin flow: login->dashboard, both Messages/Dossiers tabs work, dossier create form -> new row with auto ref (GLS-2026-21E5), status change via select correctly triggered window.prompt for note and persisted status='declaration', delete triggered window.confirm and removed row + showed success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: seed_admin does not clear failed-login attempts / lockout (playbook mentions brute-force lockout after 5 fails - NOT implemented; consider adding if required).
server.py: startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event; consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan handler.
DossiersPanel.jsx uses window.prompt/confirm which are blocking and not accessible; consider replacing with a proper modal (shadcn dialog) for better UX.
Tracking.jsx: input auto-uppercases which is fine, but backend already normalizes case in /api/track - redundant but harmless.
No brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (no rate limit/lockout); playbook mentions requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ dossiers via API/UI; created GLS-2026-21E5 via UI (deleted). GLS-2026-JB57 seed retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/{backend_test.py,test_dossiers.py} covers auth, contact, dossiers CRUD, public tracking. All pass against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. UI test verified admin dossier flow including window.prompt (accept with text) and window.confirm (accept) via page.on('dialog', ...). Playwright must call `page.on('dialog', handler)` BEFORE triggering select_option/delete.
